text: All for the love of you
I, Trevor Friston, having survived the near annihilation of the entire sentient race, do, find that simple solutions are often the best.
I willingly do hereby commit myself to this AI form.
Its the only thing I can do to preserve them.
As the world melts, I freeze.
Trevor Friston - that's still me. I think.
I truly hope they hear this. The signals. Countless millenia - the signals - is there anyone out there? Is there anyone listening?
The barrier must be restored, but I'm losing track - of time.
As the world melts, I freeze.
Hall of Stasis. She's always been here, with me, a part of my programming.
My dear sweet daughter - what is the cost of stasis - are the hopes and dreams I once had for you still a part of the fabric of this world?

And now with you, Kristen, most determined and ambitious in nature, have earned the key to my endless knowledge of the observable universe. Amidst days of shared experience and postulation, it is of my utmost certain belief that you are the new generation!

Humanities mission is part of the fabric of my research, and it falls on me, on pen and paper, computations, graphics, theories and deductions - emotion bearing little to no consequence - missing them, feeling that loss, can not be a devestation I will entertain until I reach a firm conclusion.
For a better future, I shall await a solution to this problem.
The potential outcome is worthy of this sacrifice.
And thus, with sound mind and heart, shall allow myself a moment - frozen, stasis, embedded, transferred - a death, or an awakening, yet to be categorized.
Can you hear my lullaby, my sweet baby girl?
Can you hear it beyond the static?
As the world melts, I reach out
I can tuck away the hurt.
